Source span-13 uses generic 有価証券 in an inclusion phrase, not the target-defined term. Thus targetDefinesTerm and sourceUsesSameTerm are not both established.
issues.recommendedAction: Reconsider both USES_DEFINITION conditions against target span-1 and source span-13 and change the finding to not_established unless a target-defined term actually matches.
